Travel Moments & Memories

🇯🇵 Japan

Staying at Biwako Ryokusuitei Ryokan — a peaceful onsen retreat by Lake Biwa.

The iconic Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa, Tokyo — Japan’s oldest Buddhist temple.

Afternoon at a Kyoto temple — calm pathways, maple trees, and timeless charm.

Before the majestic Osaka Castle — one of Japan’s most recognizable landmarks.

Visiting Nara Park — surrounded by deer, history, and friendly locals.

Feeding the sacred deer at Nara — they really do bow for crackers!

The Great Buddha of Kamakura — centuries of devotion in one serene gaze.

Geeking out at the Evangelion exhibit — standing beside the EVA-01 unit!

Couldn’t miss a picture with Super Saiyan Gogeta — anime fan dream unlocked.

The glowing Glico Man sign — Osaka’s energy and color summed up in one shot.

Fresh sushi in Kyoto — a quiet moment of flavor perfection.

Late-night ramen in Osaka — warmth, umami, and the perfect ending to the day.

Evening stroll through Marunouchi — Tokyo lights and architecture in harmony.
